releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.1.0 (Govt Exam Batch Resizer & Text Autofetch Pro Fix)
changelog:
🚀 Major Upgrade v10.1.0:
• Fixed In-Place Text Editor Autofetch: Exact chromatic ink color sampling (blue pen, red seals, pencil toner preserved), precise typographical cap-height font scaling, zero coordinate drift, and jitter-tolerant tap detection.
• Govt Exam Batch Target Resizer & Converter Studio: Upload 20+ mixed JPG/PDF files, compress/pad to exact target KB (20KB signature, 50KB photo, 100KB ID, 200KB PDF), cross-convert formats, and 1-Click ZIP Archive & WhatsApp Share.
• Intuitive 4-Hub Dashboard: Flagship Hero Studio Banner and 4 prominent, high-contrast category action cards eliminating hidden sub-menus.
